name: aeg-d-gc-baumgardt
title: Milky Way globular clusters: light-weighted line-of-sight dispersions from the Baumgardt database, with King-model light and population mass-to-light ratios
description: Atlas conversion of the binned velocity-dispersion profiles of the Baumgardt Galactic Globular Cluster Database (v4, treated as a re-analysis, D-042) into one g_obs and g_bar per cluster at the 3D half-light radius (D-025): light-weighted dispersion with King (1966) weights from McLaughlin & van der Marel (2005) (D-036 ii, D-045), Harris (1996, 2010 edition) distances and luminosities, and population M/L_V from McLaughlin & van der Marel (2005) (D-039). Proper-motion profiles are recorded, not plotted. See REPRODUCTION.md, REPRODUCTION_RESULT.md and checks/.
x_licence_status: No licence stated by the database ('If you use these profiles for your research, please give reference to the papers'); Harris catalogue free with citation; McLaughlin & van der Marel via VizieR (CDS terms). Atlas tables intended CC BY 4.0 under D-004, citing the sources. Source files not redistributed.
